rule: Level population in order: budget = open tiles in the 80x80 window / 30 (x1.5 multiplayer, capped at 190). Scatter groups of 1 (first level or 50 percent) else 2-3 (second level, crypt) or 3-5. Groups walk from a free anchor on one transparency region. Theme rooms pick one species and fill each open tile with a one-in-f chance. Uniques with a pack bring 8 leashed bodyguards of their own type at 2x hit points; the leader steps only when all leashed members are in a 7x7 gate box (DirOK); a separated member reunites within walking distance 3 with a clear line (GroupUnity); pack members share the leader's wake timer (FollowTheLeader). Wake: seen sets 255, unseen counts down, zero is dormant. Defects: y-step uses deltaX (line 341); anchor loop uncapped (328-331); scatter fill uncapped (3728). Decision: adapt the idea, defects fixed in the sketch.
keep: Leashed pack: the leader waits for its bodyguards inside a gate box (DirOK, monster.cpp 4356-4381).
Separated bodyguard drops out of the pack count when a wall breaks the line, so the leader does not wait (GroupUnity 1696-1722).
Shared wake timer across the pack (FollowTheLeader 1674-1690).
One species per room picked once (themes.cpp 360) with a one-in-f fill per open tile (363-365).
Density as a number per open tile (monster.cpp 3713), with a cap.
change: Group walk moves y by a second random deltaX (line 341); one direction must move both axes.
Anchor search (328-331) and scatter fill (3728) are uncapped; add caps and log the shortfall.
Diablo species, boss roster, names and sprites are not ours.
Hellfire and difficulty multipliers (3366-3377) become our own tuning fields.
Donor has no respawn or despawn (grep monster.cpp and levels/*.cpp); row 23 needs them from elsewhere.
look_test: Target src/fight/pack.ts, row 4. Stub one portrait room at 375 wide: a boss with two same-species bodyguards with the gate on; the same four bodies roaming with the gate off; a one-species room at one-in-three then one-in-nine density. Dom judges whether the boss waiting reads as a squad or a bug, whether the room reads as one thing from the door, and at which density it stops feeling like one crowd. Then cap active attackers at 3 and judge the held bodies.
